tweets.text: People mistake trading as purely accumulating capital, but really trading is a self examination of self where all your mental leaks are on full display. You must conquer yourself before you can truly become great.

thread_tweets.text: People mistake trading as purely accumulating capital, but really trading is a self examination of self where all your mental leaks are on full display. You must conquer yourself before you can truly become great.
thread_tweets.full_text: People mistake trading as purely accumulating capital, but really trading is a self examination of self where all your mental leaks are on full display. You must conquer yourself before you can truly become great.

thread_tweets.text:
You may think you're fully composed under all scenarios but what if you suddenly go up 100x in stakes? Do you think you'd react the same when instead of making or losing a few thousand from intraday swings, it's suddenly a few million?

Will you still retain the mental fortitude?

I've struggled with this countless times over my own career.  

Trading is an exercise in detachment where you must simultaneously be numb to the swings but also remain hyper critical of your performance.
